# TronGrid Lite Program ABI memory layout.
#
# Generated from the compiler by libs/program-abi/tools/abi_manifest.c. Do not edit: run
#   cmake --build <dir> --target tgl_abi_manifest_write
# and commit the result. A test compares this file against the layout on every build.
#
# Published so that a Program written in a language which cannot consume a C header can
# still check its own struct definitions, and get what the header's static assertions give
# a Program written in C.
#
#   abi-version <n>                     the layout below belongs to this ABI version
#   pointer-size <bytes>                every pointer in the interface
#   struct <name> <size> <alignment>    all sizes and offsets in bytes
#   member <struct> <name> <offset> <size>
#
# No struct here contains padding, so a struct's members always account for all of it.
